overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs Loviisa 3 Person Hybrid Outdoor Sauna with PureTech™ Full Spectrum IR or Traditional Stove offers a luxurious and versatile wellness retreat right in your backyard. Designed for outdoor use, this sauna combines the benefits of a traditional stove with an 8.0 kW built-in control and Full Spectrum IR technology, featuring 11 IR emitters for comprehensive heat therapy. Crafted with a stunning Canadian Red Cedar interior and a Vanilla Crème finish, it provides a serene environment enhanced by a galaxy star color therapy lighting system. Enjoy the health benefits of muscle relaxation, stress relief, and improved circulation, all while listening to your favorite tunes via Bluetooth connectivity and built-in performance speakers. Perfect for those seeking a premium, spa-like experience at home.

Product Ad-Copy: With a Golden Designs all-weather exterior outdoor Hybrid (Traditional Stove or Full Spectrum Infrared) sauna, you can turn that dream of your very own home spa into a reality. Even where space is at a premium, you can still enjoy the good life in the form of a delightfully relaxing and invigorating steam sauna in the comfort of your own home.
Our Barn Series brings even more relaxation with an all-natural Canadian Red Cedar interior finish, providing an invigorating rich aroma to your sauna session.

Golden Designs outdoor Hybrid (Traditional Stove or Full Spectrum Infrared) saunas provides a healthier way to live. Enjoy the wealth of health benefits a traditional or full spectrum infrared sauna brings to your life. Take the first step to a healthier life!!
